<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: unverified — Making .table-scroll a positioned ancestor addresses the stated root cause and leaves the sr-only th spans in place. The 375px scrollWidth must be confirmed by the screenshot run.
- A2: unverified — The region keeps role=region and tabindex=0 and is renamed 'Timing and depth of each breath', which differs from the pane's 'Breaths in view'. The axe result at 375px and 1280px comes from the proof run.
- A3: unverified — The diff only adds a CSS position and changes a label, so no new violation is expected. The axe comparison against main must come from the proof run.
- A4: unverified — No existing test is modified and two new test files are added. Lint, typecheck and test results are not shown in the diff.

<details><summary>3 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- CSS tests assert source text, not layout `src/app/globals.test.ts:15` — Keep the test as a guard if wanted, but rely on the Playwright scrollWidth check for A1.
- Row-count assertion depends on bare <tr> markup `src/app/cloud/session/Waveform.test.ts:20` — Use `/<tr[\s>]/g` and drop line 19.
- position: relative now applies to every .table-scroll `src/app/globals.css:488` — No change needed now.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: CSS tests assert source text, not layout
suggestions.detail: The test regex-matches the globals.css source. It passes for any rule body that contains these declarations, even if a later rule or media query overrides them. It also breaks on harmless reformatting, such as a grouped selector or the selector not starting a line. It cannot show that scrollWidth stays at 375; only the A1 screenshot run proves that.
suggestions.repro: Change the rule to `.table-scroll, .bt-scroll {` and the rule() lookup throws. Or add a later `.table-scroll { position: static; }` and the test still passes.
suggestions.fix: Keep the test as a guard if wanted, but rely on the Playwright scrollWidth check for A1.

suggestions.title: Row-count assertion depends on bare <tr> markup
suggestions.detail: `match(/<tr>/g)` only counts rows rendered with no attributes. If body rows ever get a className or key-driven attribute, the match returns null and the test fails for reasons unrelated to the region name. The `not.toBe("Breaths in view")` assertion on line 19 is also redundant after the exact `toBe` on line 18.
suggestions.repro: Add `className="row"` to the <tr> in BreathTable's tbody and the test fails with 'expected null to have length 2'.

suggestions.title: position: relative now applies to every .table-scroll
suggestions.detail: Every absolutely positioned descendant of any .table-scroll now resolves against the wrapper and is clipped by its overflow-x: auto. Today that is what the sr-only spans need. A future tooltip or popover inside a scrolling table would be clipped, though.
suggestions.repro: None in this diff; this is a forward-looking note.
